body:
### Summary

uv tree do not respect the `--group` arg


```toml
[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "ruff==0.16.2",
]
airflow = [
    "a2wsgi==1.10.10",
    "aiofiles==25.1.0",
    "aiohappyeyeballs==2.7.1",
    ...
    ]
```

running

```shell
uv tree --group dev --depth 1
```

it show all dependencies of the groups airflow and dev

### Platform

Linux 7.0.0-28-generic x86_64 GNU/Linux

### Version

0.12.2

### Python version

3.14
title: uv tree --group dev not showing only dev
